4 x DIMM slots, Max. 128GB, DDR4 3200/3000/2933/2800/2666/2400/2133 Non-ECC, Un-buffered Memory* 
 Dual Channel Memory Architecture 
 Supports Intel® Extreme Memory Profile (XMP)

rows.label: Stockage et restrictions
rows.value:
Total supports 2 x M.2 slots and 4 x SATA 6Gb/s ports* 
 Intel® Core™ Processors (14th & 13th & 12th Gen)* 
 M.2_1 slot (Key M), type 2242/2260/2280 (supports PCIe 4.0 x 4 mode)
